final: SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)) AS diff FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY diff DESC, o.account_id LIMIT 10
